Class CommerceAssociation

java.lang.Object
associations.CommerceAssociation
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class CommerceAssociation extends Object implements Cloneable
Represents an association of Commerce objects.

Groups multiple commerces (of any subtype) together under a common address and president. Provides collective management operations such as adding a commerce, replacing a Restaurant with a CarDealership, and listing all employees of member dealerships.

Author:
Juan Carlos Alfaro Jiménez

    • addCommerce

      public void addCommerce(Commerce commerce)
      Adds a Commerce to the association. The commerce will not be added if:
      • it is already present in the array (checked via Commerce.equals(Object)), or
      • the array has reached its maximum capacity.
      Parameters:
      commerce - The commerce to add

    • replaceRestaurant

      public void replaceRestaurant(Restaurant restaurant, CarDealership carDealership)
      Finds the given Restaurant in the association and replaces it with the provided CarDealership. The search uses Restaurant.equals(Object) for comparison. If the restaurant is not found, no change is made.
      Parameters:
      restaurant - The restaurant to look for and replace
      carDealership - The car dealership to put in its place

    • printDealershipEmployees

      public void printDealershipEmployees()
      Prints to standard output the details of all employees working in the car dealerships that are members of this association.

      For each CarDealership found, the method prints its name followed by each employee's Employee.toString() output.
